say:1:1230167001:1.text: I owe this to Mr. Bols' kindness.
say:1:1230167001:1.source_cn: 这一切都要感谢好心的波尔斯先生。

say:2:1230167002:1.text: Life was tough for everyone when the dock was closed earlier. During that time, Mr. Bols would come from his inn to give us some nickels from time to time.
say:2:1230167002:1.source_cn: 之前封港，大家都不好过，波尔斯先生有时候会离开旅店，给...

say:3:1230167003:1.text: Everyone says Bols isn't a good sort. It's because he runs errands for the Carmine Whispers to keep his business going.
say:3:1230167003:1.source_cn: 虽然大家都说，波尔斯也不算什么好人，他靠帮血薇帮办事，...

say:4:1230167004:1.text: Anyway, he'll always be my savior so long as he pays me for my work and provides me with food!
say:4:1230167004:1.source_cn: 但是，只要愿意给我酬劳和面包，他就是我的恩人！
